profile_text: As a leading provider of vehicle leasing and fleet management services, this company supports businesses in managing their vehicle fleets, contributing to its 48.4% growth since the baseline. With a focus on tailored leasing solutions, it has expanded its operations to meet the increasing demand for flexible and cost-effective fleet management options. With 365 employees in 2024, the company continues to scale its services to meet the evolving needs of its clients.
